collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-24  -  THE HEALER'S HONESTY SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: A healer is asked whether an unfamiliar plant will certainly relieve a villager's persistent discomfort.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A healer is asked whether an unfamiliar plant will certainly relieve a villager's persistent discomfort.

choices.label: Explain What Is Known and What Remains Uncertain.
Review Earlier Notes About the Plant.
Focus First on the Villager's Immediate Comfort.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The villager appreciates the honesty and agrees to discuss available care.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The villager feels disappointed, but the healer does not offer false reassurance.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Together they identify a familiar treatment with better-understood effects.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Neither healer has sufficient evidence, and they recommend observation and supportive care.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The notes reveal conflicting observations that warrant caution.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The healer discovers that the plant was previously confused with another species.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: Rest and appropriate care ease some discomfort without resolving its cause.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The symptoms persist, and the healer continues monitoring the villager carefully.
